Description: Published Jan 2016 - Nov 2026; (a) generates or reconstructs a 2D visual or motor output (drawing, painting, handwriting, trajectory); (b) explicit sequential, action-based or structured (program) representation, or explicit claim of inspiration from human creation; (c) empirical evaluation reported.

Recognition-only; raster image-to-sketch or offline handwriting images; sketch used only as input; robotics without drawing output (robotic drawing kept); 3D sketches; CAD; animation of existing sketches; rule-based filters with no learned or optimised model; non-peer-reviewed repository deposits (SSRN, Zenodo, etc.; arXiv preprints kept); posters; reviews (used for snowballing).
OpenAlex records whose abstract is missing or does not state whether the output is sequential; listed for full-text check, not counted as included.
Computed automatically on abstracts (regex in column headers' sense); they are screening aids, not the D/J/P/B coding of S1, which uses full texts.
On 2026-11-15 the arXiv screening reasons were re-audited: 21 records wrongly excluded were included and the reasons of the others were recomputed with the same rules as the OpenAlex screening.
Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore and ACM DL were not queried (no institutional API access); queries for them are given in Search_log.xlsx.
